This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Troxan]] who served his [[Species/Legends|species]] as a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], this Troxan visited the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to deliver an [[incendiary packet]] addressed to [[Grand Master/Legends|High Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. The Troxan was greeted at the door by a [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]], which he took as a slight&mdash;he wanted to speak only to a full-fledged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The boy, a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]], was soon joined by his master, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Maks Leem]], who used the Force to calm the Troxan envoy. She swore to deliver the package directly to Yoda, and the Troxan handed it over. He then boarded a [[flier]] and flew away.<ref name="Y:DR 2">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', Chapter 2.</ref>
